What is the Workbench?

One Space for
All Your Entities

The Workbench is your command center. Whether you're managing accounts, clients, or projects, it gives you a unified 360° view of every entity—with all related data, conversations, and actions in one place.

No more tab-switching. No more context loss. Everything you need to make informed decisions is right here.

Unified Entity Views

See accounts, clients, or projects with complete history and context.

Evidence-Backed Insights

Every insight is linked to source data—emails, tickets, meetings.

Entity 360 View

See Everything About
Any Entity

Whether it's an account, client, or project, the Entity 360 view aggregates all related data—CRM records, support tickets, Slack threads, meeting notes, and more—into a single, comprehensive dashboard.

Unified Data

All CRM fields, billing history, product usage, support tickets, and communication threads in one view.

  • Account details & hierarchy
  • Contact relationships
  • Revenue & billing data

Complete History

Temporal timeline showing how the entity evolved—from first contact to current state.

  • Deal progression timeline
  • Communication history
  • Product adoption milestones

Relationship Graph

See how this entity connects to others—related accounts, shared contacts, linked projects.

  • Parent/child accounts
  • Cross-entity dependencies
  • Influencer mapping

AI Twin Insights

Your AI Twin Watches.
You Decide.

The AI Twin continuously monitors your entities, identifies patterns, and surfaces insights in your Insights Inbox—prioritized by urgency and impact.

Proactive Monitoring

Your Twin watches for anomalies, risks, and opportunities—so you don't have to manually check every account every day.

Prioritized Queue

Insights are ranked by urgency and impact. Critical renewal risks appear at the top. Low-priority updates at the bottom.

Smart Filters

Filter by entity type, urgency level, source system, or team member. See only what matters to you right now.

Approval Gates

AI Suggests.
You Approve.

Nothing executes without your explicit approval. The AI Twin can draft emails, schedule meetings, or update records—but only you can hit "Approve."

Human-in-the-Loop

Every suggested action requires your approval. No autonomous execution. You're always in control.

Trust by Design

Your approval is the final gate before any action executes.

This isn't just a safety feature—it's a core architectural principle. The AI Twin can reason, suggest, and draft, but it can never act autonomously. You maintain complete control over what happens in your business.

Collaboration

Work Together.
Stay Aligned.

The Workbench isn't just for individual users. Teams can collaborate on entities, share notes, assign tasks, and maintain a shared understanding of what's happening.

Shared Notes

Leave notes on any entity. Tag teammates. Create threads. Everyone stays on the same page.

Task Assignment

Assign follow-ups to team members. Track completion. Never drop the ball on critical actions.

Activity Feed

See who viewed, edited, or commented on an entity. Full transparency on team activity.
